$comment: Advisories that cannot be fixed today, each with a documented reason. Entries match on npm package name + GHSA id (from the advisory URL). Keep this list empty whenever possible.

allowlist.name: extract-zip
allowlist.reason: No fixed extract-zip release exists (latest is 2.0.1, the affected version). Only npm-suggested fix is a semver-major Electron 43 upgrade, which risks the native better-sqlite3 ABI pipeline. Dev-time-only exposure: extract-zip is used solely by Electron's install script to unpack trusted electron release zips downloaded from GitHub. Remove this entry once a patched extract-zip ships or Electron is upgraded past the affected range.
